title: Ocular Dysbiosis in Eyelid Disease
official: Prevalence of Ocular Dysbiosis Across Distinct Blepharitis Phenotypes: A Multicenter Observational Natural History Study
summary: The goal of this observational study is to determine the presence and prevalence of fungal organisms in four distinct blepharitis populations.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults 18 years or older, able to provide informed consent
* Clinical diagnosis of symptomatic moderate-severe anterior blepharitis (VAS subject reported eye irritation greater than or equal to 40 (0-100 scale), VAS subject reported eye itchiness greater than or equal to 40 (0-100 scale))
* Willingness to undergo lash epilation / lid margin sampling
* If both eyes qualify for study, the worst eye will be enrolled into the study as determined by investigator's medical judgment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active ocular infection requiring urgent treatment
* Topical or systemic antifungal treatment within past 3 months
* Severe ocular surface disease precluding sampling
* Immunocompromised states (optional exclusion depending on investigator judgement)
